name: Orangutan: Reborn
summary: Orangutan Runners is making an exciting comeback with a fresh revival that not only honors its predecessor but elevates the experience to an entirely new level. This updated version promises to surpass the original in every way, offering enhanced gameplay, improved graphics, and a host of innovative features designed to keep players engaged. Whether you’re a longtime fan of the classic or a newcomer ready to dive in, the game is set to deliver more fun, more challenges, and more excitement than ever before.
